name: Sirra Von'Indi
summary: In Darkshire, Sirra Von'Indi studies the records that hold Duskwood's history. The town's historian knows ancient languages and helps decipher mysterious documents and the region's past.

sections.title: The Town Historian
sections.body: In Darkshire Town Hall, Sirra Von'Indi keeps the settlement's archives. While the town guard faces threats in the woods, he studies old texts and preserves the history of Grand Hamlet from before shadow fell across the region.

sections.title: Deciphering the Hermit's Words
sections.body: When Darkshire's leaders grow suspicious of Abercrombie, the hermit living on Duskwood's hills, they ask Sirra Von'Indi to translate his notes. His knowledge of languages helps the council make sense of the strange requests coming from the haunted woods.

sections.title: Tragedies of the Past
sections.body: Sirra Von'Indi knows the sorrowful history behind a weathered grave in Darkshire's cemetery. He is one of the few who remembers how the paladin Morgan Ladimore fell, and gives travelers the context they need to bring peace to restless spirits.

faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi is Darkshire's human scholar and official historian. In the town hall, he studies ancient arts, translates obscure languages, and keeps the town's historical records.

faq.q: Where can Sirra Von'Indi be found?
faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi can be found in Darkshire Town Hall, in central Duskwood. He stands among desks and bookshelves, consulting historical texts.

faq.q: What role does he play with Abercrombie's note?
faq.answer: When a strange note from the hermit Abercrombie reaches Lord Ello Ebonlocke and no one in the town hall can read it, Sirra Von'Indi translates it. His work helps the council understand Abercrombie's odd demands.

faq.q: What does Sirra know about Morgan Ladimore?
faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi knows the full history of Morgan Ladimore, the fallen paladin buried in the Weathered Grave. He recounts Ladimore's descent into madness and tragedy after the Third War.

faq.q: Why does Sirra make travelers wait while translating?
faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi often asks travelers to give him time while he translates. Deciphering obscure dialects and old handwriting takes care, and he cross-checks his references to make the translation reliable.

angles.text: As a mage visiting Darkshire, you may recognize Sirra Von'Indi's academic discipline. His study of ancient languages and history echoes the archival research practiced in the Kirin Tor.
As an Alliance traveler, you can see Sirra Von'Indi helping preserve Darkshire's civic life and the heritage of the Kingdom of Stormwind in a province consumed by darkness.
